entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hello, I need to start a return for a VeloBand Cadence Sensor I recently purchased.
I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your name and order number to pull up the details?
Sure, the name is Sam Jones, order number VF-8675309.
Thank you, Sam. I see the order here. Received on December 25th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's just a preference. It works fine, but I don't like the feel of it on my wrist while I'm cycling. I was actually trying to process the return on your website yesterday, but it wasn't working.
I'm sorry to hear you had trouble with the site. What happened when you tried?

It seemed like a major website error. The whole returns portal felt like it was part of a system down event. I got to the final step, but I couldn't print the label. The page just timed out. I even took a screenshot of the error message.

Thank you for that detail, Sam. Let me check... Ah, yes. I can confirm we had a brief, known outage with our returns portal yesterday afternoon. My apologies for that inconvenience. Let's get this sorted for you right now.

I'm pulling up the return policy now... Okay, I see here that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. Since you received it 9 days ago, you are well within that window. I'll go ahead and process that full refund for you.

Oh, 90 days? That's great, thank you. I appreciate you making it right. Since there was that issue with the website and it did cause me some extra trouble, would it be possible to get a small discount code for a future purchase? I'm still a fan of VeloFit, this particular band just wasn't for me.

I understand completely, and I'm glad we could get the return approved. Unfortunately, my system doesn't allow me to generate discount codes for returns. However, I can confirm I've just emailed you the prepaid return shipping label. Once our warehouse scans the item, you'll see a full refund processed within 3-5 business days.
Okay, that's fair enough. I had to ask. Getting the return processed is the most important thing. Thanks for your help, Alex.
You're very welcome, Sam. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Have a good one.
You too. Thanks again for calling VeloFit.
